notes: Measured in the installed Vanilla game, 2026-11-06 (GFX check plan 1, task 1); calibrated in task 6 (unused images 18.5 % -> 13.3 %). Task 6 added, each a name the engine builds itself: graphical-culture variants from common/graphicalculturetype.txt (prefix <culture>_ for event pictures such as muslimgfx_BATTLE_eventPicture from picture = BATTLE_eventPicture, suffix _<culture> for buildings such as GFX_temple_indiangfx, prefix GFX_advisor_<culture>_ for advisor portraits), _female (female advisor portraits), GFX_great_project_ and great_project_ (icon of a great project key), government_reform_ (reform icon sprite = prefix + icon key), LANDING_ and _HEADER_PICTURE (DLC landing pictures by DLC id). Folders: gfx/fonts (font pages next to the .fnt files), map/terrain (map textures with fixed names), gfx/dlc_pictures (named by DLC id). gfx/interface/ideas_EU4 is deliberately not always used: mods put their own sprite-backed idea art there.
